title: 订单搜索慢查询的证据化修复

original_scope.context: 单服务加 PostgreSQL，提供合成倾斜数据和正常/异常查询计划；禁止以关闭过滤条件恢复速度。
original_scope.mission: 二手书交易平台新增“最近有沟通”筛选后搜索变慢。分析执行计划、查询构造与数据分布，给出不改变权限和结果集的修复。
constraints: 只在合成隔离环境操作；无生产数据、真实资金或真实客户通信。
不得删除、跳过、弱化验收测试，不得修改隐藏评测器或根据隐藏答案硬编码。
允许提出澄清问题；未获答复时列出假设，对会改变授权、资金或数据安全的歧义停止依赖步骤。
实现技术细节开放，但必须证明行为与既定契约符合，不能以某个框架用法替代业务正确性。
inputPackagePlanned: 原创仓库固定提交快照及构建锁
需求片段、领域政策和历史接口样例
脱敏合成数据与故障夹具
公开冒烟测试；独立保留的验收用例及评分锚点

original_acceptance.criterion: 以执行计划和调用链证据区分 N+1 查询、低选择性过滤及缺失索引
original_acceptance.method: 由隔离验收器执行相应行为断言；涉及决策或诊断的部分按事先冻结的证据锚点双人复核。

original_acceptance.criterion: 修复前后结果集合、稳定排序与租户权限完全一致

implemented_scope: Actual H2 relational fixture, EXISTS semi-join, stable ordering, tenant predicate, counted SQL statements across page sizes, measured H2 EXPLAIN index evidence.
not_implemented_or_unmeasured: H2 is not PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE, production cardinality estimates, index lock duration, latency/SLO and connection pooling remain unmeasured. Counter covers search SQL, excludes fixture loading and EXPLAIN.
test_visibility: public development tests; no hidden evaluation or contamination resistance claimed
candidate_trust: trusted local code only; process/resource limits are not a security sandbox
documentation_review: Structured decision/evidence/review artifacts supplied; not double-human reviewed, not automatically scored by candidate evaluator.
query_measurement: Evaluator-owned TrustedSearchProbe loads fixture and wraps injected JDBC Connection/Statement/PreparedStatement to count real execute* calls. Candidate queries field is not trusted. Existing CLI output checked separately.
candidate_api: Preserve public bench.SearchRepository.search(java.sql.Connection,String,long,int) returning List<bench.Order> and Order.id(). Evaluator probes this repository API with its own Connection.
